events.text: YTL Power International Bhd reported Scope 1 emissions of 3,921 kilotonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent, Scope 2 emissions of 150 ktCO2e, and a first Scope 3 disclosure of 45 ktCO2e for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2023.
YTL Power International's 2023 sustainability report sets a Group target to become carbon neutral in operations by 2050.
YTL PowerSeraya is targeting a 60% reduction in Scope 1 GHG emissions by 2030 (from 2010 levels) and carbon neutral Scope 2 by 2030.
Wessex Water aims for net zero operations by 2030 and YTL PowerSeraya targets a 60% emissions reduction by 2030, as reported in YTL Corp's fiscal year ended June 30, 2023 sustainability report.
YTL Power plans to develop Malaysia's first 500MW green data centre park in Kulai, Johor, integrated with on-site solar photovoltaic power.
